canonicalTitle: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
synopsis: To cover her mother's medical bills, Natalie marries Sebastian, the supposed black-sheep son of a rich family, in her stepsister's place. The husband she thinks is a broke troublemaker is secretly the one controlling the family's billions.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband

synopsis: Selene, an orphaned pack servant who has never shifted, learns on her 18th birthday that her fated mate is Alpha Jackson, the man who torments her and intends to reject the bond. Their forced proximity slowly turns rejection into obsession.

Dumped for a richer woman, Summer impulsively agrees to marry a total stranger — CEO Norton, who needs a wife to satisfy his grandmother. Their contract marriage keeps threatening to become the real thing.

Pressured by her boyfriend's mother, Caroline vanishes without revealing she is pregnant. Seven years later NHL captain Easton joins the LA Vipers and finds her working as a rink janitor, unaware the little girl with her is his daughter.

canonicalTitle: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
synopsis: After three years of being used as her husband's convenient blood donor, Joyce files for divorce. The family that sneered at her as a gold-digger discovers too late that she is the hidden heiress to a billionaire empire.

aliases.aliasTitle: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress

canonicalTitle: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!
synopsis: Swapped in for her half-sister, Ciara is married off to comatose billionaire Adrian to pay her grandfather's medical bills. The arrangement gets complicated when the groom wakes up.

aliases.aliasTitle: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!

canonicalTitle: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis
synopsis: Murdered by her husband Jack in the future, Blair is thrown back in time with one month to rewrite her fate. She protects herself — and gets even — by marrying Nathan, Jack's fiercest rival.

aliases.aliasTitle: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis

canonicalTitle: Snatched a Billionaire to be My Husband
synopsis: Broke and newly single, Grace decides her next husband will be rich — and ends up entangled with Jarred, her ex-boyfriend's billionaire uncle. Family dinners become a battlefield.

aliases.aliasTitle: Snatched a Billionaire to be My Husband

synopsis: Teacher Charlotte Swan starts fresh at the elite St. James Academy, where campus king Timothy Wolfe decides he wants her. Her own dark secret could destroy them both if it surfaces.

A human woman becomes the unlikely mate of a dying Dragon King and may be the only person able to break the ancient curse consuming him. Court schemes and rival factions stand between her and his survival.
Facing eviction, Khloe signs on as the paid wife of CEO Jasper, who must marry and produce an heir to keep his position. A matchmaker's business arrangement steadily turns into a real love affair.

canonicalTitle: I Married as the Replacement Bride
synopsis: Defying her father, mafia daughter Martina takes her sister's place at the altar beside a feared don known as 'the Butcher.' Her terrifying new husband proves nothing like his reputation.

aliases.aliasTitle: I Married as the Replacement Bride

synopsis: Trapped in an engagement to the abusive Patrick, Aurora falls for his older brother Noah, a mob boss who will do anything to claim and protect her. Family loyalty and forbidden desire collide violently.

canonicalTitle: How My Boss Became My Hubby
synopsis: To shake off a persistent ex, secretary Allison texts him that she is dating her CEO, Lucas — and the claim accidentally goes public across the company. The fake relationship quickly stops being fake.

aliases.aliasTitle: How My Boss Became My Hubby

synopsis: After years as Andrew's contract companion, Rosalyn is diagnosed with a failing heart just as he announces his engagement to someone else. She marries another man, and her old flame refuses to let go.

Six years after his fiancée dumped him for being poor, Noah returns as a billionaire bent on revenge, not knowing his mother forced the breakup. Learning the truth upends everything he came back to do.
On Daphne's 18th birthday her alpha father is murdered — and the killer is Atlas, the man she has loved all her life. Caught between the mate bond and vengeance, she fights to reclaim her pack.

canonicalTitle: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!
synopsis: Murdered by her husband, Adoria wakes up back in the past with full knowledge of what is coming. She starts by buying the winning Mega Ball ticket, then systematically ruins everyone who betrayed her.

aliases.aliasTitle: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!

canonicalTitle: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love
synopsis: Leslie needs a green card after being dumped; billionaire heir Simon needs her rare bone-marrow match to save his brother. Their transactional marriage keeps drifting away from strictly business.

aliases.aliasTitle: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love

synopsis: For seven years Sam is treated as a useless freeloader by his wife Winnie and her family. He finally walks out and reveals he is the CEO of Zenith Group, leaving the family to face how badly they misjudged him.

Natalie, a hybrid of werewolf and dragon-vampire blood, lives hidden in the woods until an alpha's invasion kills her parents. Pulled back into pack politics, she falls for an enemy while uncovering what she truly is.
When CEO James announces his engagement, Sophie hands in her resignation and ends the secret five-year arrangement between them. Losing her forces him to confront what she actually meant to him.
Secretary Lucy wakes from a one-night stand to discover the stranger is Luke Walker, the CEO she answers to at work. Keeping the affair secret at the office proves impossible.

canonicalTitle: Oh No! I Slept with My Husband!
synopsis: Beth married Nathan under family pressure and the two have barely seen each other in three years — so neither recognizes the other during a drunken hotel hookup. The mistaken one-night stand reboots their paper marriage.

aliases.aliasTitle: Oh No! I Slept with My Husband!

canonicalTitle: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes
synopsis: Fleeing the abusive ex who once locked her up, Kara is rescued by biker leader Leo, who introduces himself as her boyfriend on the spot. The rough rider turns out to be a billionaire with secrets of his own.

aliases.aliasTitle: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes

synopsis: Kaiya, a werewolf cursed never to shift, discovers her fated mate is Talon, a vampire — the sworn enemy of her kind. Their bond forces both species' ancient feuds and his dark secrets into the open.

A last-minute seating change on a college road trip puts Anna next to her boyfriend's father Lincoln, a powerful attorney about to become her boss. The forbidden attraction sparked in that car spirals out of control.

Given a second chance at life, Francesca wakes at fourteen on the day she rejoined her mafia family. This time she allies with Enzo, the disgraced eldest son, restoring him as heir to rewrite the betrayals that destroyed her first life.

canonicalTitle: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten
synopsis: Genius hacker Abby, abused by the governor who adopted her and sold off before her 18th birthday, uses DNA matching to find her biological father — billionaire Dominic Mancini. She returns as his sole heir, with three fiercely protective brothers behind her.

aliases.aliasTitle: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten

synopsis: Aria's strict mafia father weds her to the ruthless enforcer Luca Vitiello to seal an alliance between crime families. Behind her dangerous husband's violence she finds unexpected protectiveness, and the arranged match turns real.

Dumped and publicly humiliated by her husband on their third wedding anniversary, a woman turns out to be the daughter of the richest man in America and the real source of her ex's fortune. A same-day accidental marriage to a dashing billionaire hands her wealth, a mysterious new identity, and the means to strike back.

canonicalTitle: Spoiled by My Billionaire Baby Daddy
synopsis: A cash-strapped college student agrees to a one-night arrangement with the cold heir of a chaebol dynasty plagued by generational infertility, then discovers she is carrying twins. He pulls her into his gilded world, determined to give her the protection and luxury she has never known.

aliases.aliasTitle: Spoiled by My Billionaire Baby Daddy

synopsis: To dodge a politically motivated arranged match, a pampered heir pretends to be gay and engaged to a new executive at his company. He has no idea his fake fiance is an undercover agent investigating his family's corrupt dealings.

canonicalTitle: The Bad Boy Who Ruined Me
synopsis: Quiet math prodigy Hazel arrives at LA Tech determined to keep her head down, then accidentally shatters a luxury watch belonging to Zach, the campus bad boy and billionaire heir. He gives her an ultimatum, pay the debt or spend time with him, and her orderly life unravels.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Bad Boy Who Ruined Me

canonicalTitle: A Deal With The Hockey Captain
synopsis: Nerdy college girl Dora joins the hockey team as an assistant and strikes a bargain with captain Troy to help her win over her crush Leo. As her confidence grows, unexpected sparks with Troy complicate the whole arrangement.

aliases.aliasTitle: A Deal With The Hockey Captain

synopsis: Hoping to win her crush before graduation, shy Aria recruits his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy. The lessons work a little too well, and she starts falling for the teacher instead.

Jenny's one rule is to never get involved with Xavier, her brother's rival and the league's most notorious hockey playboy. After he catches her in a compromising moment, the two tumble into a secret fling that threatens to blow up her family loyalties.

At her own parents' anniversary party, a woman is sneered at as a broke nobody and her diamond gift is dismissed as fake. Her relatives have no idea she is a powerful CEO, and she is done staying quiet about it.

To repay a debt of gratitude, Neil signs a secret five-year marriage contract with Keira's father and quietly devotes himself to mending her broken heart. When the contract expires and she still pines for her old flame, he chooses to walk away.

canonicalTitle: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss
synopsis: Cast aside by the man she quietly propelled to success, Eleanor, the hidden CEO behind the powerful Thunder Circle, is dragged back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage. High society is not ready for who she really is.

aliases.aliasTitle: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss

synopsis: Taken in by the Reynolds brothers after her family's bankruptcy, Joy is framed by a scheming newcomer and becomes the household scapegoat. Fed up after years of mistreatment, she leaves to marry a powerful heir, and the brothers only learn the truth once she is gone.

After two years in a passionless marriage, Charlotte realizes her distant husband has always loved his stepsister and only married her as a cover. She exposes the truth and walks out, leaving him to drown in regret.

Framed by her family's adopted daughter, biological heiress Ashley loses years to prison while everyone, including her fiance, believes the lie. On the day he stages a wedding with her rival, she fakes her death in a fire, and the family's remorse comes far too late.

canonicalTitle: No Escape From The Mafia King's Embrace
synopsis: On Valentine's night, nurse Lydia saves a dying stranger who turns out to be feared mafia king Soren Moretti, and he offers her a brutal choice: marry him or die. As their 30-day love contract winds down, her defiance and their desire become impossible to untangle.

aliases.aliasTitle: No Escape From The Mafia King's Embrace

canonicalTitle: Love and Bloodlust at Vampire Academy
synopsis: Human teenager Margo enrolls at the first boarding school to integrate mortals with the wealthy vampire elite. Surrounded by predators, she must survive campus politics while resisting the pull of a magnetic vampire prince.

aliases.aliasTitle: Love and Bloodlust at Vampire Academy

synopsis: Falsely accused of drugging Nolan after their one-night stand, Carey is cruelly cast aside and left to raise their child alone. Two years later she starts a new job and discovers her boss is Nolan himself, still unaware of the child she has been hiding.

canonicalTitle: Watch Out! I Call the Final Shots
synopsis: Arthur Storm secretly runs the mighty Titan Group but is discarded by the woman whose rise he bankrolled. When a mysterious billionaire's marriage proposal rocks high society, his true identity comes roaring into the open.

aliases.aliasTitle: Watch Out! I Call the Final Shots

synopsis: Brilliant aerospace engineer James shelves his career for his wife and ends up washing cars while she heaps resentment on him. Pushed past his breaking point, he walks out, reclaims his hidden identity, and builds a fortune, leaving her to reckon with what she threw away.

canonicalTitle: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King
synopsis: On a New York-bound flight, tech heiress Anya offers stranger Arthur a fake marriage to escape an arranged one, not realizing he secretly leads the Titan Group. After his own fiancee dumps him, a dramatic gala reveal turns the tables on everyone who wrote him off.

aliases.aliasTitle: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King

canonicalTitle: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
synopsis: When PTA queen bees frame her son, a supposedly ordinary mom is humiliated and pushed aside by the school community. What no one knows is that she is the secret billionaire who owns the school, and now she gets to decide their fate.

aliases.aliasTitle: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom

canonicalTitle: The Lost Heir: A Christmas Reckoning
synopsis: A maintenance worker's fiancee steals his patent, dumps him, and mocks him with her new partner at the office holiday party. Then a stranger crashes the event, reveals himself as the man's long-lost tycoon father, and the two plot a Christmas payback no one will forget.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Lost Heir: A Christmas Reckoning

synopsis: Broken by his parents' deaths, legendary mech pilot Colt hides as a lowly janitor under the wing of Freya, the woman he secretly loves. When she is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, he unleashes his hidden identity and a 100 percent neural sync to save her and the world.

canonicalTitle: The Beggar King A Greek Curse
synopsis: Imprisoned by Zeus for three ages, Titan heir Orion falls to the mortal world with the mind of a child and lives as a priestess's supposedly foolish live-in husband. As enemies force her to end the marriage, his divine powers finally awaken.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Beggar King A Greek Curse

canonicalTitle: The Day You Were Forever Gone
synopsis: She faked her own death to escape her husband's grip, and returns years later, hollowed out by their daughter's death, to make him feel every wound she carried. His failing health and a final confession of love throw her revenge into doubt.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Day You Were Forever Gone

canonicalTitle: Nine-Tailed Reborn: Beasts at My Command
synopsis: Reborn on the very day she must choose a mate, fox queen Vera rejects the man who betrayed her in her past life and picks Caleb, an underestimated shapeshifter with untapped potential. Armed with memories of the future, she builds him into a force that can face her scheming sister and a ruthless dragon lord.

aliases.aliasTitle: Nine-Tailed Reborn: Beasts at My Command

canonicalTitle: The Chef from Tomorrow: Crowned by Flavor
synopsis: Bankrupt chef Ethan stumbles onto a magical restaurant system that shuttles him between the modern world and the ancient kingdom of Valen. His futuristic cooking takes the capital by storm, winning him allies, royal favor, and dangerous enemies.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Chef from Tomorrow: Crowned by Flavor

canonicalTitle: A Contract Meant to End, A Love Meant to Be
synopsis: Single mom Claire's one-night stand with billionaire Ethan leaves her pregnant with the one baby whose cord blood can save her dying son. Their contract marriage begins as a cold transaction and slowly thaws into a real family.

aliases.aliasTitle: A Contract Meant to End, A Love Meant to Be

synopsis: Heiress Elena hides her wealth to marry engineer Logan for love, then spends three years on a starvation allowance dictated by his money-controlling mother. When her health collapses, the marriage and a startling financial secret both come to a head.

canonicalTitle: Lord of Oblivion: Death Knows My Name
synopsis: Damon wakes in a parallel world as a college sophomore clutching a love letter from a campus beauty who died years ago, and his own time is running out. A mysterious system awakens and offers him one game-changing choice, starting with accepting the dead girl's invitation.

aliases.aliasTitle: Lord of Oblivion: Death Knows My Name

canonicalTitle: Love Me When I Am Gone
synopsis: To pay her father's medical bills, Rosie takes her runaway twin's place and signs a three-year marriage contract with Mason. Just as her devotion finally reaches him, his first love returns; Rosie quietly serves out the contract and vanishes, leaving him with the truth and his regret.

aliases.aliasTitle: Love Me When I Am Gone

canonicalTitle: Back With Baby, Ex Regrets Deeply
synopsis: Jilted at the marriage office by her fiance, Vanessa enters an arranged marriage with a billionaire abroad and returns three years later with their young son. When her old flame and his new partner humiliate her, her husband strikes back and his long-hidden love for her comes to light.

aliases.aliasTitle: Back With Baby, Ex Regrets Deeply
Back With Baby, Ex Regrets Deeply

canonicalTitle: Rejected at the Altar, Claimed by the Cursed Alpha
synopsis: An omega with rare silver blood is publicly rejected by her fiance at their mating ceremony, and his cursed half-brother steps in to claim her instead. Their bond heals his curse and propels him toward becoming the true Alpha King with her as his Luna.

aliases.aliasTitle: Rejected at the Altar, Claimed by the Cursed Alpha
Rejected at the Altar, Claimed by the Cursed Alpha

synopsis: Cast off and humiliated by her ex-husband, Nora starts over as nanny to the son of New York's most powerful mafia don. Caring for the boy draws her into a dangerous romance with the don himself while her past threatens to unravel it all.

Rescued from kidnappers by Alpha Allen, her fated mate, Olivia falls hopelessly in love with him. But she secretly belongs to the kind that murdered his parents, and the truth could destroy their bond.

canonicalTitle: They Messed with the Wrong Luna
synopsis: Thrown out on the day of her bonding ceremony so her mate could register another female's pup, a she-wolf crosses the border and weds the continent's most powerful Alpha. Three years later she returns, and her ex has no idea the legendary Luna he awaits is the woman he discarded.

aliases.aliasTitle: They Messed with the Wrong Luna

synopsis: A manager tries to coerce a lowly office cleaner into sleeping with him by threatening her job. He discovers far too late that the woman mopping the floors is the company's CEO.

Diana stands up for the humiliated Leon, then is pushed into a marriage to rescue her family. As Leon quietly destroys her enemies and helps her rebuild after her family's company collapses, the two grow ever closer.

Executed outside the East Palace by the cruel Crown Prince in her first life, Serena wakes again on the day the Emperor is to decree her marriage. This time she asks to wed the prince's uncle instead, turning her second life into a weapon of retribution.

canonicalTitle: I Helped My Husband's Brother Take the Mafia Throne
synopsis: Drowned by her mafia husband, a woman returns to life bent on payback. She lets him squander his empire on his first love while she partners with his exiled brother to seize the throne for themselves.

aliases.aliasTitle: I Helped My Husband's Brother Take the Mafia Throne
I Helped My Husband's Brother Take The Mafia Throne

synopsis: A modern doctor's failed experiment flings him into an ancient kingdom, where he wakes as husband to a princess. He leans on present-day science to win her heart and help the struggling nation rise.

canonicalTitle: My Fiancé Humiliated Me, I Wed the War General
synopsis: Ordered by her fiance to wear a mistress's pink gown at their royal wedding, a duke's daughter takes her grievance straight to the queen. When the groom skips the ceremony for another woman, his war-general brother marries her in his place and the schemers lose everything.

aliases.aliasTitle: My Fiancé Humiliated Me, I Wed the War General
My Fiancé Humiliated Me, I Wed the War General

canonicalTitle: Ten Years Betrayed, Ten Years Awaited
synopsis: After a decade as a devoted housewife, Vivian discovers the son she raised isn't hers and walks away. Reclaiming her seat as chairwoman of the Noble Group, she exposes her husband's double life and fights to win back her real child.

aliases.aliasTitle: Ten Years Betrayed, Ten Years Awaited

synopsis: Nick, heir to a conglomerate, hides his background and sells cars after his family rejects his girlfriend, only for her to dump him for a wealthy man and treat him with contempt. When he finally reveals who he is, the people who looked down on him are consumed by regret.

On her wedding day her Alpha throws her to the wolves and comforts his true love while her own brother helps destroy her future. She survives the betrayal, and as the pack prepares a new mating ceremony for her replacement, she comes back for everything they took.

canonicalTitle: My Ex-Wife Came to Remarry Me the Day My Billionaire Wife Showed Up
synopsis: Three years after their divorce, Ethan's ex-wife returns convinced he'll honor an old bet and remarry her, pressuring him alongside her childhood friend. She has no idea he is already happily married to the heiress of the capital's richest family, and her schemes end with her empire collapsing.

aliases.aliasTitle: My Ex-Wife Came to Remarry Me the Day My Billionaire Wife Showed Up

synopsis: On her first wedding anniversary, Siena nearly dies when her husband and his old flame deliberately trigger her severe nut allergy and dismiss her suffering. The betrayal pushes her to call on her powerful real family, turning a toxic mafia marriage into a reckoning.

canonicalTitle: From Rags to The Hidden Heir's Bride
synopsis: Publicly dumped by her fiance on prom night, Maeve impulsively marries a delivery man who turns out to be a secret billionaire heir. Their spur-of-the-moment marriage deepens into real love as his identity unravels and enemies close in.

aliases.aliasTitle: From Rags to The Hidden Heir's Bride

canonicalTitle: The Stand-In Bride: A Drama Queen You Can't Mess With
synopsis: An adopted daughter is pushed into marrying a supposedly blind tycoon in another's place, but both spouses are hiding things: she secretly commands a business empire and he is faking his blindness for revenge. Their contract marriage becomes a game of mutual unmasking.

aliases.aliasTitle: The Stand-In Bride: A Drama Queen You Can't Mess With

synopsis: When her Alpha husband sides with his brother's widow over their mate bond, hidden Lycan princess Mia flees into a blizzard with her son and is rescued by the Lycan King who has quietly loved her for seven years. Reclaiming her royal identity, she returns to take back her throne and settle scores.

canonicalTitle: Blood and Bones of the Disowned Daughter
synopsis: After a rival is unmasked as the family's true heiress, Natalie is framed for her grandmother's murder, disowned, and sent to a brutal reform school. Released two years later and forced to wed a drunken playboy, she coldly begins settling every score.

aliases.aliasTitle: Blood and Bones of the Disowned Daughter

synopsis: Juliet secretly runs a top financial conglomerate while playing the ordinary girlfriend for seven years, only to be dumped by her ungrateful boyfriend. She flash-marries his own boss and readies a banquet reveal that will floor her ex.

Sold by her own boyfriend to mafia king Vincenzo as a contract bride, Violet plots her escape until she realizes the feared don genuinely loves her. After he is gravely wounded saving her, she marries him for real, just as assassins target the wedding.

canonicalTitle: My New Daddy is a Five-Star General
synopsis: Jessica's husband spends their son's brain-surgery fund on his affair, forces a divorce, and then frames her to bury evidence of a murder. The army's top general steps in to help her fight back, and their pursuit of justice grows into romance.

aliases.aliasTitle: My New Daddy is a Five-Star General

synopsis: Freed after years in psychiatric detention, Chaim is still haunted by visions of his murdered fiancee urging him toward vengeance. He hunts the four men behind her death, opening a meticulously calculated revenge with a brutal strike at a wedding.

Reborn on the very day she must choose a fiance, Yvonne rejects the first love who betrayed her in her past life and picks a quiet man destined to become a tech magnate. This time around she uncovers his long-hidden devotion and finally chooses the right person.
After discovering her mafia husband's infidelity and secret family, a woman stages her own death to escape him. Her disappearance triggers his desperate search and a spiral of betrayal and payback.

canonicalTitle: Big Bad Daddy You Are Busted
synopsis: Eddie, a onetime underworld lord living quietly, has his calm shattered when CEO Nora Olson returns with the child he never knew about and demands he step up. A flash marriage drags him into family betrayal, corporate war, and the revelation of his own hidden lineage.

aliases.aliasTitle: Big Bad Daddy You Are Busted

canonicalTitle: He Chose Too Late to Love Me
synopsis: Attacked at home on her fifth wedding anniversary, a wife calls her CEO husband for help, only for him to abandon her to be with his first love. By the time his regret arrives, she is already done with the marriage.

aliases.aliasTitle: He Chose Too Late to Love Me

synopsis: Med student Miles stages a fake affair to get back at his cheating influencer girlfriend and accidentally kisses CEO Hunter instead. Two men who both swore they were straight find that one kiss rewrites everything.

CEO Paul Smith loses his empire when his adopted children and an old college friend betray him. Backed by a new ally, he engineers a comeback at a tech chip competition and watches the conspirators face justice.

canonicalTitle: Medical Genius Is Not Someone to Mess with
synopsis: After divorcing the husband who cheated and fathered a child with another woman, surgeon Grace rises to lead a top medical center, endures his family's cruelty, and watches them implode when a dinner-party bombshell proves the boy was never his son.

aliases.aliasTitle: Medical Genius Is Not Someone to Mess with

synopsis: Dumped on his wedding day, Leo accepts an arranged match with Vivian, Europe's feared mafia queen; when he later returns to New York and his true identity comes out, he settles old scores and learns his wife has loved him in secret for years.
